title: Bluey's Happy Snaps
summary: Bluey's Happy Snaps is Gameloft's Bluey game for Switch 2, with a release date of October 15, 2026 and a price of $39.99. The pre-release listing puts it at 3.5 GB, which may change at launch but is small either way. The physical version is a Game-Key Card, so the cartridge only unlocks the download; if you are buying it as a gift, the console will need an internet connection before the game can be played. Two players can play together on one console, which suits a parent playing with a child. It supports 10 languages, including Spanish.
